name: Knock
description:
Choose an object within medium range that is locked, blocked, stuck or barred. The object becomes unlocked, unblocked, unstuck or unbarred. If the object is affected by a spell preventing access, that spell is suppressed for 10 minutes.

When you cast the spell, the object emits a loud knock, which is audible from within far range. Roll Lore to see if you trigger any additional effects.

Describe the sound.
successes:
✨: The knock is emitted at a low frequency that does not seem to come from any particular direction.

🌞: The knock is only audible within long range.

💀: The knock is intensified to a small explosion, which deals 2d6 damage to objects and creatures within or adjacent to the object and is audible within a quarter mile. Check a condition.
